{{Quote|Patrol 118 to central! We have been ambushed by terrorists and are in need of reinforcements!|The OOM command battle droid|<ref name="Front Runners" />}}
This '''OOM command battle droid''' was part of the [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|droid occupation]] present on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in the city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] and was in command of [[Patrol 118/Legends|Patrol 118]]. The group was ambushed by [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]] lead by [[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]] in hope for the droids to contact reinforcements that included a [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|tank]] to proceed further within their plan. This [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was destroyed by [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]] after it had called for backup.
